profile_text.body:
Lokalise is a continuous localization and translation management platform founded in 2016 and headquartered in Newark, Delaware. The company describes itself as a system that connects localization workflows, standardizes execution, and integrates into software development pipelines so that teams can ship localized products more quickly. Its platform centralizes translation management across teams and markets.

The company's primary AI product, Lokalise AI, sits within the localization and translation management space and is noted as UK-hosted. The platform applies AI to enforce approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary across languages, and uses what the company calls Custom AI Profiles to supply context and metadata intended to preserve meaning in translation. An AI Scoring feature evaluates translation quality automatically, routing only low-confidence results for human review. Lokalise also describes dynamic LLM routing, in which the system selects and connects to the best-fitting large language model based on language, content, and context, without requiring repeated configuration by users. Role-based access control is applied across the platform and its API, with the same model governing both the web interface and API access.

Held facts show Lokalise is incorporated in Delaware and carries 14 items of law exposure associated with that state, though no specific litigation cases are recorded. The company has no MCP server presence in the registry at this time.
